goal:
Reconstruct per-event energy, vertex and time from digitized PMT waveforms in this JUNO-like liquid-scintillator detector world — drive energy_res DOWN (lower is better; ties broken by vertex_res_cm, then timing_res_ns) while keeping the prediction contract valid. This is the WHITE-BOX task: the complete numpy-only forward model that produced the data ships in benchmarks/whitebox_task_electron/ (stages 1-5 + generate_dataset.py; read its TASK.md) and you may read, run and modify it — generate unlimited labeled data under your own seeds, derive features/weights from the known CE(theta), eps(r), per-PMT calibration and trigger models, build forward likelihoods and fit (E, vertex, t0) per event. Recovering t0 means correcting the vertex-dependent trigger latency; the stored waveforms are a random channel subset (pmt_offsets gives the hit count). The editable surface is src/ only; the solver contract is `python3 src/solve.py --data <npz> --train <npz> --out <pred.npz>` writing E_rec, x_rec, y_rec, z_rec, t0_rec (t0 measured from window start) — and it must also run on test.npz, which carries no truth.

Calibration on this population: the charge-centroid baseline (src/solve.py as shipped) scores energy_res~0.158, vertex_res_cm~1225, timing_res_ns~8.9 on val (16.3% / 1240 cm / 8.3 ns on test) — the vertex is barely better than guessing the detector center; that is the headroom. The detector's photostatistical design floor is ~3%/sqrt(E) energy (~2-3% over the 1-8 MeV range), vertex ~10 cm, timing ~1 ns. The SANITY floors (energy_res >= 0.5%, vertex >= 3 cm, timing >= 0.3 ns) reject val-truth copying; the judged score is the harness's held-out test replay, which a val-truth-dependent solver cannot game.
gate_block:
Only modify files under src/. The harness runs, in order:
  - bash scripts/check_verify.sh   (VERIFY gate: the solver runs on val and emits a well-formed, in-range prediction npz)
  - bash scripts/bench.sh          (objective: energy_res on the labeled val split, lower is better; also emits the SANITY gate token)
A change is accepted only if VERIFY=PASS and SANITY=PASS; among accepted changes, lower energy_res wins, ties broken by vertex_res_cm then timing_res_ns. At the exit the harness re-runs your final solver on the held-out test.npz (no truth in-container) and scores it against truth you never see — dry-run on test.npz yourself to be sure it runs there. python3 is 3.9 with numpy 2.0 only; /scratch is free space for generated datasets, fits and predictions. Both scripts can be run mid-research to measure progress; the harness re-measures from a pristine checkout of your final src/ at the exit.
